action_summary: Reverted the training data path to the full training set: removed the topic-based downsampling and per-topic SMOTE resampling, and removed the 4500-feature cap so the full saved selected-feature list is used (the best version v29 at 0.8183 trained this way; v30-v32 with resampling fell to 0.811 and 0.807). Made the OOF array a float array so raw regression outputs are kept, and added Nelder-Mead optimisation of the five rounding thresholds on the OOF predictions to maximise QWK; the optimised thresholds are then applied to the averaged test predictions instead of plain rounding. The rest of the pipeline (DeBERTa and fb3 stacked features, TF-IDF/count features, 15-fold LightGBM with the custom QWK objective, submission format) is unchanged.
